simulate_memory_usage: simulate memory usage for a given node ordering in a computation graph using the Simulator class

review_simulator_class: review the Simulator class to understand how it tracks edge reference counts and memory per timestep

test_simulator_simulate: test the Simulator Simulate method by providing a graph and node ordering and verifying peak memory output
